info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Valuation Model Creation API
info.description: This API allows users to create new financial instrument valuation models, essential for assessing the value of various financial assets. It serves financial analysts, investment firms, and banking institutions that need to develop and customize valuation methodologies. By providing a structured interface to submit model parameters and specifications, users can ensure accurate modeling aligned with market dynamics. This endpoint facilitates seamless integration into financial applications, supporting better investment decision-making and risk management practices.

post.summary: Create a new financial instrument valuation model.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new financial instrument valuation model by providing the necessary data in the request body. After a successful request, the new model will be available for use in valuations and analysis.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update financial instrument valuation models. It expects a JSON object containing the relevant data required for the operation.

201.description: The financial instrument valuation model was created successfully.
